title: incident-bot: enrich on-call escalation context with rotation, runbook links, and SLO hints
description:
Motivation: on-call engineers need richer context in pager messages and incident threads to make faster decisions. This PR enriches the escalation context card produced by incident-bot with (1) current on-call rotation details (who's primary/secondary, schedule window), (2) last pager and recent acknowledgement history, (3) direct runbook links (resolved via slo-toolkit runbook hints), and (4) quick SLO diagnostic links generated by the SLO Toolkit integration.

What I changed: single continuous description with checklist below.
- Add a new escalation_context resolver that queries the oncall service and slo-toolkit runbook resolver.
- Surface an "on-call card" in Slack/Teams messages with rotation, last-pager summary, and runbook links.
- Add fallbacks when runbooks are not found (suggest related SLOs).
- Add unit tests and integration harness for the resolver.
- Update Dockerfile and entrypoint to include new environment variables (ONCALL_API_URL, RUNBOOK_CACHE_TTL).

Checklist:
- [x] Add resolver and unit tests
- [x] Add integration test that mocks oncall and SLO responses
- [x] CI passes on rerun
- [x] Docs updated (oncall runbooks doc)

Notes on behavior and rollout:
- This is backwards-compatible: if oncall or runbook services fail, incident-bot falls back to the existing minimal escalation context.
- Feature gated behind EXPERIMENTAL_ENRICHED_ESCALATION (off by default). We will enable for SRE alpha channel first.
- Metrics: new counter incident_bot.escalation.enrichment.{success|failure} and latency histogram.

Related: Linear ENG-7284 (oncall UX), SRE-119 (runbook discovery improvements).
